name: Howe Antique Shade 1830
description: Antique Shade titling capitals and figures from the 1830 J. Howe & Co. specimen.
observed: Complete A–Z capital alphabet, figures 0–9 dollar sign and printed punctuation &,-;’!: directly sampled from Brevier Antique Shade, unnumbered PDF page 109 (archive leaf 109).
reconstructed: No inferred visible characters. Lowercase input aliases the capitals; ASCII apostrophe aliases the observed closing apostrophe. Word space, metrics and digital spacing are new. The historical source-size label identifies the supplying impression; the font is freely scalable.

sources.title: Specimen of printing types and ornaments, J. Howe & Co. (1830), Brevier Antique Shade, unnumbered PDF page 109
sources.rights: 1830 US publication, public domain by age. Library of Congress scan; the retained archive record states that the Library is unaware of copyright restrictions.

revival.author: Harold Lehmann
revival.notes: Exact native JP2 and lossless quarter-turn retained. A measured rigid rotation corrects page tilt; see reference/derivation.json. Source row labels are provenance, not separate products.

character_set_notes: Complete historical capitals-only titling alphabet, figures and the accompanying observed symbols. Lowercase input aliases capitals. Unsupported modern symbols are omitted.
